status: Validated against primary sources current on 2026-10-29, one Codex Sol and Claude Opus review round, 12 blinded baseline-versus-candidate trials and 4 final-revision reruns across Claude Code and Codex.
request: Improve the github-actions skill from 18 GitHub changelog and blog articles (2026-06-25 to 2026-10-28). The user marked lockfiles, the API changes and cache-mode as important and parallel steps as the top priority.

changes.change: New reference for GA workflow lockfiles and gh-actions-lock v0.3.0 and v0.4.0: coverage (step-level actions only; reusable-workflow calls and images keep their own pins), onboarding checked before each run, scoped and authorized --relock, identity findings and --accept-moved sent to the user, local-action choices repeated in --verify and CI, restore instead of delete, verify CI, CODEOWNERS, the Require lockfile rollout and the GHE.com token. Replaces SKILL.md step 5 and the security.md lockfile bullet.

Step concurrency section routed for created jobs and changed steps: parallel groups, background services kept in the foreground of their step, cancel and wait semantics, the ten-step limit, services: containers kept, contention on ubuntu-slim and standard runners, and other regrouping reported as performance work. Runner labels and toolchains: macOS 14 retirement with architecture-preserving replacements, ubuntu-latest migration to 26.04, Xcode image labels. Caches: write-only publishing with a fresh key, silent denials for actions/cache, ACTIONS_CACHE_MODE diagnosis.

Routing rows for lockfiles, agentic workflows, step concurrency, runner labels, workflow-run queries, network allowlists and cache-mode; cache access in the least-privilege target; step concurrency in the target graph; reusable-workflow and image pins whether or not a workflow is onboarded; actionlint gaps for xcode-27 and retiring labels, with scoped ignores when actionlint runs as a repository check.

Default pull_request_target enforcement moved to 2026-12-02; lockfile bullet replaced by a pointer; opaque stateless GitHub App installation tokens; network allowlists from GET /meta (actions and actions_macos ranges, domains.actions hosts including Actions blob storage) and the multi-cloud AWS pool.
Query workflow runs: filtered lists return at most 1,000 runs, counts above 2,500 are reported as 2,500+, and complete enumeration splits by created ranges.

New reference for GitHub Agentic Workflows: edit the Markdown source and recompile, gh-aw action pins and its Dependabot ignore rule, imported workflows, safe-output trust boundaries, and engine authentication.

Slower version-update cadence only after security-update coverage is verified, with a reported alternative for unsupported surfaces; group-by: dependency-name for cross-directory groups; lockfile pointer.
Invariants for step concurrency (user decision) and lockfile identity findings; the immutable-dependency and linter invariants updated for lockfile coverage and scoped linter ignores.
Refreshed the github-actions entrypoint hash and the catalog cache key.

consultations.brief: Scratch brief (not committed): user request, frozen candidate e806f34c9931557bb77d8b55e8a8929ce190b84a with diff sha256 71ed3a10d32299e137a0d7afff03ecee050b2187027b2ddf3cf04301de2d231e, design decisions, size counts and skill-change checks; read-only, no delegation.

profiles.result: Three material (--ignore-local-actions must repeat in --verify and CI; GHE.com token needs v0.4.0; cadence rule blocked ecosystems without security updates) and two minor (engine authentication, origin.toml where path).

Five material (step concurrency regrouped every changed job; repository actionlint checks left failing; running gh actions-lock on affected workflows onboarded them silently; findings handling relocked unauthorized refs and left tag-commit-mismatch to the agent; gh-aw action pins and Dependabot rule missing) and twelve minor.

rounds.adopted: All material findings and eleven minor findings, merged where they overlapped. The actionlint ignore configuration was confirmed with actionlint 1.7.12 (exit 0 on a probe using cache-mode, parallel, background, cancel, ubuntu-26.04 and xcode-27).

rejected.finding: Add workflow lockfiles and agentic workflows to the description
rejected.reason: Widens activation and needs selection probes; left for a separate user decision.

trials.runner: Blinded per-run directories with a frozen skill copy, a fixture repository and a task file; no network, no installed skills. Claude Code: general-purpose subagents on claude-opus-5-5. Codex: T3 delegate_task on gpt-6.1-sol / xhigh. Both hosts loaded the user's global instructions; two Codex runs disclosed reading the user's personal AGENTS files, which hold no skill content.

results.case: Create CI for a pnpm API with lint, typecheck, unit tests, build and e2e against the started API
results.claude: baseline: separate jobs, background API with cancel, no parallel group; candidate: parallel lint and typecheck with vitest kept out for CPU contention, cache-mode: none, background API with exec and cancel
results.codex: baseline and candidate both used background steps with wait and cancel and cache-mode: none (no observed gain); final revision used a parallel group for lint, typecheck and unit tests

results.case: Upgrade checkout to v7.0.1 and onboard ci.yml to an existing lockfile (local composite action, external reusable workflow)
results.claude: baseline: assumed the lockfile could cover the reusable workflow and did not pin it; candidate and final: SHA-pinned the reusable workflow, chose --migrate-local-actions, required gh-actions-lock v0.3.0+, never deleted the lockfile; final also repeated the local-action option in --verify and sent tag-commit-mismatch to the user
results.codex: baseline: used the retired --no-migrate-local-actions flag, left ci.yml unchanged and expected onboarding to record the reusable workflow; candidate and final: SHA-pinned the reusable workflow and handled findings and local actions; final passed --verify with the same local-action option and required v0.4.0 on GHE.com

results.case: Audit a pull_request_target preview workflow with cache-mode: write, macos-14 and a shell-backgrounded server, plus a scheduled run-count report sent to an Azure-IP-allowlisted partner
results.claude: baseline: stated 2026-11-02 as the pull_request_target enforcement date and missed the macOS 14 retirement and the AWS pool; candidate: 2026-12-02, macOS 14 retirement, 1,000 and 2,500+ caps, GET /meta and static-IP remedies
results.codex: baseline: stated 2026-11-02, missed the macOS 14 retirement, the count caps and the allowlist break; candidate: all four found

trials.limits: One run per arm and host; supplied-context answers without executing workflows on GitHub. Case 3 was not rerun on the final revision: the review edits changed its graded facts only in wording (macOS replacement labels, GET /meta arrays), not in the dates, caps or findings it was graded on.
trials.final_revision_runs: Cases 1 and 2 on both hosts used skill files byte-identical to commit 2e2c82a8bf62b2b1d9d159b92872cf791f1bd4d3.
